gotchas: A '20% off your first order' discount modal (.discount_modal) covers the search results and takes clicks; open a product URL directly (/pd/…) instead of clicking from search.
Size is required before 'Add to cart' works: click a button[aria-label*="size" i] first (the add silently does nothing without one).
After adding, the mini-bag offers 'Checkout'; the next page asks 'How would you like to checkout?' — use the 'Guest checkout' link.

Shipping page: Email, Phone (input-masked; a plain fill can drop digits — select all, Backspace, then fill the 10 digits), First/Last name, Street Address with typeahead. City/State/ZIP stay hidden until a suggestion is picked or 'Enter address manually' is clicked. Picking a suggestion may open a second list of suites; 'Enter address manually' is simpler. The visible ZIP is input[id*="zip"], not the name*=postal input.
State is a <select> of full names ('California').
'Continue to Payment' can open an 'Confirm shipping address' dialog (USPS-style ZIP+4 suggestion pre-selected); click its 'Save & continue'.

Payment: Adyen Secured Fields, three iframes (titles contain 'card number', 'expiry', 'security') each holding an input[data-fieldtype="encrypted…"]. Billing same as shipping is pre-checked. Next button is 'Review your order', then 'Review and buy'.
Card fields probed read-only on 2026-10-06 and not filled, so card selectors are unverified. order.total hint not settled.
